Name: Gifts from Haley - Flowers Sunshine and Sweet Moments
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
[center][b]────────────────────────────────────[/b][/center]

[center][b][size=4]It's time to get some love back! 🎁✨[/size][/b][/center]
[center]
Let's be honest: you spend days chasing villagers around town, memorizing their bizarre schedules,[/center]
[center]and spending a fortune on rare items just to get... silence? Or maybe a recipe you'll never actually make. 🙄
[b][size=4]Those one-sided days are over![/size][/b][/center]
[center]All the dedication, effort, and hard-earned cash spent building a friendship now come right back to you.[/center]
[center]With this mod, camaraderie is a two-way street: receive unique letters and gifts at every friendship level,[/center]
[center]and the rewards get better with every single heart you earn! ❤️📈
[/center]
[center][b][size=4]Finally, making new friends is completely worth it! 🤝💥[/size][/b][/center]
[center]
Enjoy the basic perks early on and get ready to be surprised by advanced loot as your bond deepens.[/center]
[center]From common stones found on the ground to precious relics and survival tools...[/center]
[center]after all, every character has their own unique taste (and level of sanity)! 💎
[i]Clear out your mailbox, prepare your inventory space, and start enjoying the return on your investment![/i] 😉🎒[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b]────────────────────────────────────[/b] 

[b][size=4]Está na hora de receber os seus presentes de volta! 🎁✨[/size][/b][/center]
[center]
Sejamos sinceros: você passa dias correndo atrás dos moradores da vila, decora rotinas bizarras,[/center]
[center]gasta uma fortuna em itens raros e o que ganha em troca?[/center]
[center]O silêncio ou aquela receita que você nunca vai cozinhar. 🙄
[b][size=4]Isso acabou![/size][/b][/center]
[center]Toda a dedicação e o patrimônio gasto para construir uma amizade agora voltam para o seu bolso.[/center]
[center]Com este mod, a camaradagem é uma via de mão dupla:[/center]
[center]receba cartas e presentes exclusivos a cada nível de amizade,[/center]
[center]e as recompensas melhoram a cada novo coração conquistado! ❤️📈[/center]
[center]
[b][size=4]Agora sim vale a pena investir em novos amigos! 🤝💥[/size][/b][/center]
[center]
Aproveite os mimos básicos do começo da relação e se surpreenda com os itens avançados conforme a intimidade cresce.[/center]
[center]De pedras comuns encontradas no chão a relíquias preciosas e ferramentas de sobrevivência... afinal,[/center]
[center]cada personagem tem um gosto (e uma sanidade) diferente! 💎
[i]Limpe a sua caixa de correio, prepare o espaço na mochila e aproveite o retorno do seu investimento![/i] 😉🎒

[b]────────────────────────────────────[/b] 
[/center]

[size=5][b]⚙️ → Installation ← ⚙️[/b][/size][/color][/center]

[center][color=#AAAAAA][b]1. [/b]⬇️ Download the mod from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley]Nexus Mods[/url] (the only place I upload—if you found it elsewhere, run 🏃). [/color]
[color=#AAAAAA][b]2.[/b] 📦 Drop the ZIP file into your Stardew Valley [i]Mods[/i] folder. [/color]
[color=#AAAAAA][b]3.[/b] 🧠 Extract it there like a civilized human being. [/color]
[color=#AAAAAA][b]4. [/b]🚀 Launch the game using SMAPI. [/color]
[color=#AAAAAA][b]5. [/b]🎉 Enjoy your new social life![/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA]────────────────────────────────────[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA][size=5][b]🗑️ → Uninstall ← 🗑️[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA][b]1.[/b] 🧹 Delete the mod folder from your [i]Mods[/i] directory.[/color]
[color=#AAAAAA][b]2.[/b] 💔 Go back to Nexus Mods and tell me why you left me (optional, but emotionally impactful). [/color]
[color=#AAAAAA][b]3.[/b] 😢 I’ll pretend I’m fine. [/color]
[color=#AAAAAA][b]4. [/b]🌾 Go enjoy Stardew Valley without me… I guess.[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA]────────────────────────────────────[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA][size=5][b]🔄 → Update ← 🔄[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA]1.❗ Delete the old version (yes, really—don’t be lazy).[/color]
[color=#AAAAAA]2. 📥 Install the new version following the steps above.[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA][b]⚠️ Important:[/b]
 Do [b]NOT[/b] overwrite files. That’s how chaos begins 💀
 Delete first, then install the update like a responsible adult.[/color][/center]
